vson_p:
# Quantification example: "Every horse in the field is brown."
# Demonstrates: Quantification node + quantifier (closed list) + variable +
# qDomain (restriction) + scope (predicated proposition), each pointing at
# a reified Annotation node (per spec §18 — RDF 1.1 portable equivalent of
# canonical <<s p o>>).

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 50mm :framing wide_shot)
   :viewedBy cam

   :depicts (field / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Geography)

   :depicts (h1 / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Animal
               :hasQuality (q1 / Quality :dimension Color :value brown))

   :depicts (h2 / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Animal
               :hasQuality (q2 / Quality :dimension Color :value brown))

   :depicts (qf1 / Quantification
               :quantifier all
               :variable horse
               :qDomain (q_dom / Annotation
                           :annotatedSubject horse
                           :annotatedPredicate partOf
                           :annotatedObject field)
               :scope (q_scp / Annotation
                          :annotatedSubject horse
                          :annotatedPredicate hasQuality
                          :annotatedObject brown_color)))
